DECISION: Buy Monthly Membership
JUSTIFICATION: The rider has 540 rides with a total duration of 5,693.11 minutes, mostly on electric bikes. Based on the pricing page, the monthly membership costs $29/month and includes 45 minutes of free riding on classic bikes, with a per-minute rate of $0.17 for classic bikes and $0.17 for ebikes after the free minutes. The pay-per-use total is $2,371.45, while the membership total is $805.58 (monthly price x 1 month + per-minute charges). The break-even point is 12 rides per month (actual: 540 rides per month). The weekly table shows the rider's spending on a pay-per-use basis.
PAY-PER-USE TOTAL: $2,371.45
MEMBERSHIP TOTAL: $805.58  (monthly price x months + per-minute charges)
BREAK-EVEN: 12 rides per month (actual: 540 rides per month)
WEEKLY TABLE: week | rides | avg minutes | pay-per-use spend
2024-40 | 96 | 12.37 | $459.74
2024-41 | 118 | 9.15 | $471.17
2024-42 | 123 | 9.77 | $537.59
2024-43 | 121 | 11.85 | $565.69
2024-44 | 82 | 9.63 | $337.26
ASSUMPTIONS: The rider's data only covers one month, so the break-even calculation assumes the same usage pattern across all months. The pricing page does not specify any discounts for long-term members or bulk rides.

sql_log.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rides, COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS distinct_months, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips
SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY rideable_type
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 * duration_min ELSE 0.19 * duration_min END), 2) AS pay_per_use_total FROM trips
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS months, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * duration_min ELSE 0.17 * MAX(duration_min - 45, 0) END) AS member_per_minute_charges FROM trips

SELECT ride_week, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 * duration_min ELSE 0.19 * duration_min END), 2) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week LIMIT 6
